# Get Contact Detail

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Gets a detail about the given contact.

## Syntax

~~~~text
contactDetail(detail: <#Enumeration (WFContentItemPropertyName)#>, contact: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
contactDetail(detail: First Name, contact: ShortcutInput)
~~~~
